ALIGNAcme connected demo

One decision, four views, plus a phone

A goal in Acme’s plan turns into a task for Maya, Maya’s own choices decide what travels further, and her coach sees only what she chooses to send. All names and numbers are invented.

  1. StrategyOS. You are the Strategy Owner. Goal D2 (train 8 teams) is blocked because Operations has no capacity. In Goal Architecture, scroll to the draft layer. Press “Mark conversation held”, then “Send to review” on DR-1, then “Release”. A box appears showing what happened next.
  2. Enterprise. Open Operating Workflow. DR-1 is now a task for Maya R., with StrategyOS named as the source.
  3. Participant. You are Maya, in her Acme view. Under Needs Your Attention there is a new assignment. Press Accept. Then open Work Update, press the voice button, create the draft, tick “I am at capacity”, and publish. Her coach is a separate choice: press “Ask my coach to talk”.
  4. Enterprise again. Open Work Updates. Maya’s update is there. Press Accept into workflow.
  5. StrategyOS again. Open goal D2. The Enterprise box shows 6 of 11 as a group count. The people who said “at capacity” are fewer than 5, so they are not shown.
  6. Coach. Open Notifications. Maya asked to talk, topic Workload. The coach sees no assignment, no work update and nothing from Acme.

Also in this version. Maya’s Personal context keeps only DesignSuite, Career Navigator and Integrate360. In her Acme context, Career Navigator shows Acme roles only, and “Express interest” is the only thing that tells Acme. It appears in Enterprise under Retention Intelligence, by name, because she chose it. Health is her real Health context, in her Acme view because Acme sponsors it. It starts switched on so you can see it. In Enterprise, open Health Sponsorship and switch it off to watch the tab disappear. Acme sees counts of 10 or more, never who. Practitioners under this benefit must be approved and on an Align Health dashboard. Faith is not offered at work. The Program tab is an example of a context funded by someone other than the employer. The Phone tab shows Maya on mobile.
